canonical_title: NVIDIA acquisition of Hugging Face for $12.93 billion
aliases: The Information Nvidia Hugging Face deal
treatment: The acquisition is now officially announced. Reinclude only for regulatory review, closing conditions, governance or platform-policy changes, expected/actual closing, termination, repricing, or material restructuring.
known_facts: Reuters reported on August 27, citing The Information and a person with knowledge of the deal, that NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion.
On September 3, NVIDIA announced the acquisition at a $12.93 billion headline value.
NVIDIA will pay about $11.9 billion to Hugging Face investors and provide up to $1 billion in equity-based retention incentives for employees joining NVIDIA.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said Hugging Face will remain an open platform for the entire AI ecosystem and NVIDIA chips will not be required to build on or deploy through it.
NVIDIA previously invested in Hugging Face's 2023 funding round at a $4.5 billion valuation.
reinclude_only_if: A regulator opens a material review, imposes conditions, or blocks the transaction.
Closing timing, governance changes, financing details, or material platform-policy changes are disclosed.
The deal closes, is terminated, repriced, or materially restructured.
notes: FOLLOW_UP on 2026-09-03: the previously unconfirmed acquisition report became an official NVIDIA-announced transaction. Reuters publication time 2026-09-03 12:08 UTC = 21:08 JST.
